profile.headline: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer at MetLife
profile.summary: Customer, quality and result-driven Full-Stack Software Engineer experienced and successful in different software development roles including design and implementation, leading, mentoring, supporting and working with customers.

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description: Work closely with a great group of individuals to develop and support applications and data used by actuaries.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description:
Performed in an agile development team where I collaborated and wore many hats to research, design, implement, review and direct as needed at all levels of the SDLC for EngageOne Interactive - Pitney Bowes' Communication Management software.

Performed as Technical Team Lead, and Scrum Master (Team Coach) as needed.

Performed as second level support lead to manage and make implementation corrections, provide system integration recommendations and enhancements while working closely with customers, business partners, support groups, product management, architects and other development teams.

Performed in a virtual office with colleagues across the globe.

positions.title: Technical Team Lead/Programmer Analyst Specialist - Data Warehouse Support
positions.locationName: Greater Milwaukee Area and Remotely from North Carolina
positions.description: Appointed Technical Team Lead to manage, lead and train a team of developers on development and support techniques for a large and fast changing Data Warehouse environment. Managed conversion activities and planning.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst Specialist - Relationship Value Management
positions.description: Collaborated in the design of generic SOA domain models and framework used for the development of web services geared for Relationship Value Management Applications. Worked closely with developers around the globe to build new business models and web services.

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst - Electronic Funds Delivery
positions.description: Performed as technical lead on different projects for websites used for card processing. Used J2EE concepts and MVC frameworks for web applications and SOAP Web Services in a service bureau environment.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Information Systems, Math Minor, Language Translations (English and Spanish)
